note: marquee picks locked and text items
marquee uses the bare outline instead of the stroke inclusive world bounds
marquee accepts a zero area rect
anchor: guard area.maxX - area.minX > 0, area.maxY - area.minY > 0 else { return [] }

note: marquee accepts a non finite rect
anchor: guard let area = rect.normalized else { return [] }

note: marquee closed edge test excludes a rect touching the right edge
marquee hides an item with no finite box, so an overflowing stroke is never picked
replacement: guard let box = item.worldBounds, box.meets(area) else { continue }
